gaps.lead: Her French improved because she spent years in Lyon.
gaps.sentence: Her French improved as ___ in Lyon.

gaps.lead: Nobody can say that he doesn't work hard.

gaps.sentence: We packed a spare tyre ___ bad.
gaps.hint: in case = because it might happen
